title: Oxymatrine alleviates cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury by inhibiting microglia ferroptosis via NRF2 pathway activation.
authors: Wu, Nanding; Wang, Yutong; Guo, Mengjie; Ran, Ruili; Wang, Dewei; Song, Junqiu; Hui, Lishan; Yang, Jing; Yang, Yue
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氧化苦参碱通过NRF2通路抑制小胶质细胞铁死亡减轻脑缺血再灌注损伤，属神经药理学与铁死亡机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模及AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI) involves secondary damage following blood flow restoration. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent cell death process, is implicated in CIRI, with mitochondrial dynamics imbalance playing a critical role. Oxymatrine (OMT), a quinolizidine alkaloid extracted from the root of Sophora flavescens, exhibits neuroprotective properties, yet its role in modulating microglia ferroptosis and mitochondrial homeostasis during CIRI remains unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate whether OMT attenuates microglia ferroptosis in CIRI by activating the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) pathway and restoring mitochondrial dynamic balance. METHODS: Using a rat middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion model and BV-2 microglia under oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation, we evaluated the effects of OMT alone or with NRF2 inhibitor ML385 or ferroptosis inducer Erastin. Assessments included neurological scores, infarct volume, Reactive Oxygen Species, ferrous iron, malondialdehyde, glutathione, mitochondrial membrane potential, and related protein expression, including NRF2, kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1), heme oxygenase-1, solute carrier family 7 member 11, ferritin heavy chain, glutathione peroxidase 4, dynamin-related protein 1, optic atrophy 1. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, and co-immunoprecipitation were used to examine OMT-KEAP1 binding. Finally, in vitro rescue experiments using KEAP1 overexpression and CDDO-ME (a specific KEAP1 inhibitor) confirmed the KEAP1/NRF2 dependency by re-assessing cell viability and ferroptosis markers. RESULTS: OMT improved neurological outcomes and suppressed ferroptosis in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, OMT disrupted KEAP1-NRF2 binding, promoting NRF2 nuclear translocation and upregulating solute carrier family 7 member 11, heme oxygenase-1, ferritin heavy chain, and glutathione peroxidase 4. This restored mitochondrial homeostasis by balancing optic atrophy 1 and dynamin-related protein 1, thereby reducing lipid peroxidation. Crucially, these effects were abolished by ML385 or Erastin, while KEAP1 overexpression and CDDO-ME respectively mimicked KEAP1-mediated suppression and NRF2-driven protection. These findings confirm OMT acts via a KEAP1/NRF2-dependent anti-ferroptotic axis. CONCLUSIONS: OMT protects against CIRI by inhibiting microglia ferroptosis through NRF2 pathway activation and improvement of mitochondrial homeostasis, supporting its potential as a therapeutic agent for ischemic stroke.
abstract_zh: 背景：脑缺血再灌注损伤（CIRI）涉及血流恢复后的继发性损伤。铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种铁依赖性细胞死亡过程，与CIRI相关，其中线粒体动力学失衡起关键作用。氧化苦参碱（OMT）是从苦参根中提取的喹诺里西啶生物碱，具有神经保护特性，但其在CIRI期间调节小胶质细胞铁死亡和线粒体稳态中的作用尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨OMT是否通过激活核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）通路并恢复线粒体动力学平衡来减轻CIRI中的小胶质细胞铁死亡。方法：采用大鼠大脑中动脉闭塞/再灌注模型和氧糖剥夺/复氧条件下的BV-2小胶质细胞，评估OMT单独或与NRF2抑制剂ML385或铁死亡诱导剂Erastin联合使用的效果。评估指标包括神经功能评分、梗死体积、活性氧、亚铁离子、丙二醛、谷胱甘肽、线粒体膜电位及相关蛋白表达，包括NRF2、Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（KEAP1）、血红素加氧酶-1、溶质载体家族7成员11、铁蛋白重链、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4、动力相关蛋白1、视神经萎缩蛋白1。采用分子对接、表面等离子体共振和免疫共沉淀检测OMT-KEAP1结合。最后，使用KEAP1过表达和CDDO-ME（一种特异性KEAP1抑制剂）进行体外拯救实验，通过重新评估细胞活力和铁死亡标志物确认KEAP1/NRF2依赖性。结果：OMT在体内和体外改善了神经功能结局并抑制了铁死亡。机制上，OMT破坏KEAP1-NRF2结合，促进NRF2核转位并上调溶质载体家族7成员11、血红素加氧酶-1、铁蛋白重链和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4。这通过平衡视神经萎缩蛋白1和动力相关蛋白1恢复了线粒体稳态，从而减少脂质过氧化。关键的是，这些效应被ML385或Erastin消除，而KEAP1过表达和CDDO-ME分别模拟了KEAP1介导的抑制和NRF2驱动的保护。这些发现证实OMT通过KEAP1/NRF2依赖性抗铁死亡轴发挥作用。结论：OMT通过激活NRF2通路和改善线粒体稳态抑制小胶质细胞铁死亡，从而保护CIRI，支持其作为缺血性卒中治疗药物的潜力。
